title: EXTEND_FACE payload
description: Move an open boundary edge of a face within its support plane up to a target face (v0.2 §13.5, E-08; spec §10.6 rule 8; D-324).

edgeId.description: Open half-edge of the outer ring of the face to move.

targetFaceId.description: Face G; the new boundary line is plane(F) ∩ plane(G), computed by the kernel (D-324).

$comment: [P] Field names; `targetFaceId` replaces the free `targetLine` (D-324; schema change approved D-331, 3D-105).
